How to read data using the cdasws Python package¶

Workflow¶

  1. Choose observatories (e.g. 'ACE')
  2. Choose instruments (e.g. 'Plasma and Solar Wind')
  3. Choose datasets (e.g. 'AC_H0_SWE')
  4. Choose variables (e.g. 'Np', 'Vp')

reference:
https://pypi.org/project/cdasws/
https://berniegsfc.github.io/cdasws/jupyter/CdasWsDataRetrieval.html
https://cdaweb.gsfc.nasa.gov/WebServices/REST/jupyter/CdasWsIdlExample.html

In [1]:
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from rich.console import Console
console = Console(highlight=False)#,force_jupyter=False,width=999)

from cdasws.cdasws import CdasWs, TimeInterval
from cdasws.datarepresentation import DataRepresentation as dr
from cdasws.doi import get_doi_landing_page_url, get_doi_badge_url, get_doi_hdp_url

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

from IPython.core.display import HTML

today = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%B-%d')

cdas = CdasWs()

def display_link(
    url: str,
    text: str) -> None:
    display(HTML(f'<a href="{url}" target="_blank">{text}</a>'))

def display_image_link(
    url: str,
    image_url: str) -> None:
    display(HTML(f'<a href="{url}" target="_blank"><img src={image_url}/></a>'))
    

# Injects CSS to target the notebook's standard output stream container
display(HTML('''
<style>
div.output_area pre {
    font-size: 16px !important;
}
</style>
'''))

Initialize the client¶

In [2]:
cdas = CdasWs()

# Fetch all observatory groups
obs_groups = cdas.get_observatory_groups()

# Print the names
print("Observatory -> IDs\n")
for indx, group in enumerate(obs_groups):
    #print("'%s'" %(group['Name']),',', end="")
    print("\033[1;32m%s\033[0m -> %s" %(group['Name'], group['ObservatoryId']))
    #print(f"\033[1;32m{group['Name']:<0}\033[0m -> {group['ObservatoryId']}")

List the dataset IDs¶

In [5]:
### user-specified ###
my_obs_inst={}
my_obs_inst['ACE']=['Plasma and Solar Wind', 'Magnetic Fields (space)']
my_obs_inst['Wind']=['Magnetic Fields (space)']

#myobservatory=['ACE', 'Wind']
#myinstrument =['Plasma and Solar Wind', 'Magnetic Fields (space)']
In [6]:
%%time
all_datasets = []
for obs in my_obs_inst:
    for inst in my_obs_inst[obs]:
        print('Observatory: %s' %(obs))
        print('Instrument: %s' %(inst))
        print('Dataset with the link -> Label')
        datasets = cdas.get_datasets(observatoryGroup=obs,instrumentType=inst)#myinstrument)
        if datasets:
            all_datasets.extend(datasets)
            
        lines=[]
        for index, dataset in enumerate(datasets):
            dataset_id = dataset["Id"]
            dataset_label = dataset["Label"]
            dataset_note = dataset['Notes']
            #dataset_note = dataset['DatasetLink']['Url']
            #skt_url = f"https://cdaweb.gsfc.nasa.gov/pub/software/cdawlib/0SKELTABLES/{dataset_id}_00000000_v01.skt"

            #skeleton_table_text = response.text
    
            #doi_info = dataset["Doi"]

            #    metadata_url = get_doi_landing_page_url(doi_info)
            #else:
            #    # Fallback if no DOI info is provided directly in the dataset object
            #    metadata_url = f"https://nasa.gov{dataset_id}"
    
            #print('\033[1;32m%s\033[0m -> %s, %s' %(dataset_id, dataset_label,dataset_note))#, display_link(metadata_url, 'metadata')))
            #print("'\033[1m%s\033[0m' -> %s" %(dataset_id, dataset_label))#, display_link(metadata_url, 'metadata')))
            #print("%s" %(dataset_note))#, display_link(metadata_url, 'metadata')))
            #print('')
            #display(Markdown('\033[1;32m%s\033[0m -> %s' %(dataset_id, dataset_label)))#, display_link(metadata_url, 'metadata')))
            #print(f'{index}. {dataset_id}, {dataset_label}')
            lines.append("[bold green][link=%s]'%s'[/link][/] -> %s" %(dataset_note,dataset_id,dataset_label))
        console.print("\n".join(lines),justify='left', soft_wrap=True)
    
        print('='*100)
        print(' ')

Show the URL/DOI of the selected dataset¶

mydois=[]
for mydset in mydataset:
    for index, dataset in enumerate(all_datasets):
        dataset_id = dataset["Id"]
        dataset_label = dataset["Label"]
    
        if mydset==dataset_id:
        #if dataset_id in mydataset:  # select this dataset for use below
            doi=dataset['Doi']
            #print(doi)
            mydois.append(dataset['Doi'])
            print(f'\nSelected dataset: {dataset_id} (doi:{doi})')
            print(f"Available Period: {dataset['TimeInterval']}")
            display_image_link(get_doi_landing_page_url(doi), get_doi_badge_url(doi))
            display_link(get_doi_hdp_url(doi), 'HDP Description')
            display_link(dataset['Notes'], 'CDAWeb Notes')
            display(HTML(f'<b>Data Citation</b>: {cdas.get_citation(doi)}.  Accessed on {today}.'))

        var_names.append(name)

%%time
# assign parameteprs
#dataset_id = 'AC_H0_SWE'
#myvariables  = {}
#mystart_time = {}
#myend_time   = {}

### user-specified ###
time_periods={
    "evnt1": ('1998-02-04T00:00:00Z', '1999-02-04T00:00:00Z'),
    "evnt2": ('2001-02-04T00:00:00Z', '2002-02-04T00:00:00Z')
}
observatory_config={
    'ACE': {
        'AC_H0_MFI': ['BGSM'],
        'AC_H0_SWE': ['Np', 'Vp', 'V_GSM']
    },
    'Wind': {
        'WI_H0_MFI': ['BGSM']
    }
}
#######################

# request the data representation as xarray
obs_dat={evnt: {} for evnt in time_periods}
for label, (start,end) in time_periods.items():
    for sc_name,config in observatory_config.items():
        obs_dat[label][sc_name]={}
        for dset, variables in config.items():
            status, result = cdas.get_data(dset, variables, start, end, dataRepresentation = dr.XARRAY)
            keys=list(result.indexes.keys())
            result_rename=result.rename({keys[0]: "time"})
            print('Event:',label,'-','Observatory:',sc_name,'-','Dataset:', dset)
            if status['http']['status_code'] == 200:
                obs_dat[label][sc_name][dset]=result_rename
                print('Donwload Success!')
            else:
                print(f"Error! HTTP Status Code: {status['http']['status_code']}")
            print('')

If you want to convert the SPCEPY-type data into a Panda dataframe¶

Here is optional. Please use the data with the Spacepy data type (Change to dataRepresentation=dr.SPACEPY in the data_get line above).

In [ ]:
df={}
for dataset in mydataset:
    print('for %s' %(dataset))
    cdf_copy=data[dataset].copy()
    data_dict = {key: cdf_copy[key][...] for key in cdf_copy.keys()}
    #print(data_dict)
    
    first_var_name=list(data[dataset].keys())[0]    #hope the first element is Epoch
    num_elements=len(data[dataset][first_var_name]) 
    
    # since Panda dataframes requires a flat data when converting, we need to flatten the data.
    flat_dict = {}
    flat_attrs = {}
    for key, value in data_dict.items():
        print(key,value.ndim,value.shape)
        # Check if the variable is 2D (e.g., Shape is [Time, 3])
        if value.ndim == 2: 
            if value.shape[1]==3: 
                labels = ['X', 'Y', 'Z'] # Fallback labels
                
                # Expand columns out individually
                for i in range(value.shape[1]):
                    flat_dict[f"{key}_{labels[i]}"] = value[:, i]
                
                    flat_attrs[f"{key}_{labels[i]}"]= data_dict[key].attrs
        else:
            if value.shape[0]==num_elements:
                flat_dict[key] = value
                flat_attrs[key]= data_dict[key].attrs
    
    df[dataset] = pd.DataFrame(flat_dict)
    df[dataset] = df[dataset].set_index(first_var_name)
    df[dataset].index.name='time'
    df[dataset]=df[dataset].mask(abs(df[dataset])>1e30)
    
    ### add attributes
    for key in df[dataset].keys():
        df[dataset][key].attrs=flat_attrs[key]
    
    print(df[dataset].head())
    print('='*100)
    print(' ')
